newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo FIBA Nordic managing director quits.
newsitem.headline: Oslo FIBA Nordic managing director quits.

text.p: Oslo-based brokerage house FIBA Nordic Securities AS (FIBA AS) said on Monday its managing director Hans Peter Michelet had resigned.
In a statement to the Oslo bourse, FIBA said Oeystein Oeyehaug would take over the position from Tuesday and Joern Kongsoere had been appointed as managing director of parent group FIBA ASA.
FIBA AS is a wholly-owned subsidiary of FIBA ASA , which is listed on the Oslo bourse.

FIBA NORDIC Securities in Norway and London-based FIBA-linked broker FIBA NORDIC Securities (UK) Ltd (FIBA UK) came under the spotlight last year linked to a share fund scandal involving Morgan Grenfell Asset Management Ltd (MGAM).
A spkesman in Oslo said the resignation was not linked to the MGAM affair.
"He has resigned because he's going to another partnership. There is no link," the spokesman said.
FIBA Nordic and FIBA UK announced in January that they had agreed to terminate their contractual relationship.
FIBA AS owns 10 percent of FIBA UK, which in turns owns 100 percent of FIBA NORDIC Securities AB in Stockholm.
